note: Pilot: can 明治大学図書館『舊高舊領取調帳』 (IIIF, public domain) be transcribed into village → 石高 → holder rows of usable precision, under terms that allow commercial use? Instrument: scripts/histrecon/kyudaka-meiji-pilot.mjs (agreement + binding, computed from the transcription file). Transcription: scripts/histrecon/kyudaka-meiji-LI00001164.json. Nothing is drawn into data/; no assembler reads these files. The 国立歴史民俗博物館 旧高旧領取調帳データベース and the Kyudaka_agrivillage holder column were not used, opened or compared against.

verdict.summary: NOT usable at the required precision as done here. The terms allow commercial use (with attribution and a modification notice; one copy of any resulting work is requested). But the only image is a ≈1240×1100 px bitonal film print of each two-page spread, and two same-reader passes over 15 canvases agree on 98.8 % of village names, 89.9 % of 石高 and 81.3 % of holder strings — and 32 % of village names, 32 % of 石高 and 44 % of holder strings contain at least one character a pass could not read. Only the village column reaches 98 %, and only because unreadable characters are written □ instead of guessed.
verdict.agreementIsNotAccuracy: Both passes were made by the same reader in one session (no sub-readers were allowed in this pilot), so pass 2 was not independent of pass 1: where both passes read every character they agree 100 %, which measures self-consistency, not correctness. Direct evidence: pass 1 wrote the most frequent holder as «安部□□守領分» in 60 rows (17 %); a 7× crop of frame 15 made between the passes shows «松平□□衛督領分» (plausibly 松平左兵衛督 = 明石藩 — NOT asserted here), and pass 2 wrote that. A confident misreading survived a whole first pass.

terms.status: COMMERCIAL USE PERMITTED for the images (stated). Attribution and a modification notice are conditions; one copy of resulting works is requested (an outward contact — for the coordinator to decide).

corpus.image: One canvas = one two-page spread; IIIF Image API 2 level2, info.json width ≈1239–1246 px, height 1100 px (no larger native size; sizeAboveFull only interpolates). Bitonal film-like print with a frame counter (e.g. «0378») under each spread. 13–14 rows per full page, ≈26 per spread; a page with a 郡 header carries ≈11.
corpus.layout: Columns 旧村名 / 旧領名 / 明治二年取調旧高 / 旧縣名. 〃 = ditto. A village with several holders (相給・除地) is one row per holder with 〃 in the village column. 寺社領 rows carry «〃管下» in the 旧縣名 column. Each 郡 ends with a footer «一郡 N 村 / 一郡高 …»; faint pencil subtotals in the margins.

sample.frames: 3–17 (15 canvases; frame 3 = start of 美嚢郡, frame 12 = 美嚢郡 footer, frame 13 = start of 明石郡)
sample.why: 播磨 is the 国 of the first 府藩県 pilot (withdrawn: it read the 歴博 database, whose terms forbid commercial use — dev-notes hist-recon-expand); the first 15 canvases cover one whole 郡, so the 郡 footer can be checked.
sample.shortOfBrief: The brief asked for 30–50 canvases; 15 were read twice (347 rows × 2). The second pass already showed that precision cannot be held with this image and method, so more canvases would only repeat the measurement.

method: Canvas images fetched from the IIIF Image API (User-Agent «IntMap-histrecon/1.0 (+https://github.com/rwmqx7dwb5-arch/IntMap)»), cached outside the repository.
Pass 1: colour crops of each page in two 295 px-wide vertical strips (overlap ≈1 column), upscaled ×2.95 by the server; every row typed as 郡|村|旧領名|旧高|旧縣名 as written (〃 kept).
Pass 2: the same canvases as grey crops in 340 px strips at ×2.35 with shifted boundaries; transcribed without reading the pass-1 file (but by the same reader — see verdict).
Rule: a character not read with confidence is □; nothing is completed from knowledge of the place, the 藩 or a neighbouring row. 〃 is carried downward only in `resolved`.
Agreement: field equality per row, character conflicts where both passes read a character, and length conflicts (scripts/histrecon/kyudaka-meiji-pilot.mjs).

Binding: each fully read village name (agreed reading) is matched with estat-koaza.mjs matchVillages against the e-Stat 2020 町丁・字 of the modern municipalities under every N03-1920 町村 of the same 郡 (exact / prefixed levels are used; fuzzy only reported), and compared with the N03-1920 町村 names.

measured.completeness: 美嚢郡: 157 village entries transcribed in both passes; the 郡 footer on frame 12 reads «一郡百五十七村» (footer only partly legible: 郡高 «四万四千□百九十五石…» not fully read). No village row was skipped.

fuzzyNames: 押部村 ~ 押部谷村 → 神戸市西区: 押部谷町押部・押部谷町木津・押部谷町近江・押部谷町木見・押部谷町木幡・押部谷町細田・押部谷町栄・押部谷町高和・押部谷町西盛・押部谷町福住・押部谷町養田・押部谷町和田

bindingSummary.share: 55.1 % of fully read names (30.6 % of all 248 village entries)
bindingSummary.note: 16 more unmatched names are a positional prefix + a stem found in a 町丁・字 (上石野村・中石野村 → 別所町石野; 上渡瀬村・下渡瀬村 → 吉川町渡瀬; 東江井村・西江井村 → 大久保町江井島): villages merged into one 大字 after 1889. They can be drawn only as a share of that 大字 (the union), not each on its own. No 1920 町村 name equals a village name.

timing.extrapolation: 4,429 canvases × 21.6 s ≈ 26.6 h per pass of reading alone (wall clock of this session, excluding zoom checks, file writing and reconciliation); 2 passes ≈ 53 h, 3 passes ≈ 80 h. Some canvases are covers or blank (frames 1–2 here), so this is an upper bound for the reading and a lower bound for the whole job.

hardToRead.what: numerals 二・三・六 at the head of a 石高 (pass 1 «□百□十六石», pass 2 «六百九十六石», frame 4)
hardToRead.why: cursive 六 and 三/二 differ by one stroke at ≈10 px

hardToRead.what: units 斗 vs 升 and 升 vs 合, written small and stacked
hardToRead.why: reduced to 3–4 px strokes; the main source of □ in 石高

hardToRead.what: 十六 vs 十五 (frame 9: «三百十六石» vs «三百□十五石»)
hardToRead.why: a real conflict between the passes

hardToRead.what: the frequent holder «松平□□衛督領分» read as «安部□□守領分» in pass 1 (60 rows)
hardToRead.why: cursive 松平 vs 安部 at ≈10 px; only a 7× crop separated them

hardToRead.what: 屋/座 (長屋町/長座町), 平/寺 (平岡村), the first character of village names
hardToRead.why: village names lose their first character most often (15 % of village characters unread)

hardToRead.what: two-line small notes (割書) of 社寺 names and bracketed multi-holder blocks (frame 16, 近江寺)
hardToRead.why: below the resolution of the image

hardToRead.what: faint pencil notes in margins and footers (郡高)
hardToRead.why: partly washed out in the bitonal print

howToHoldPrecision: A better image first: the IIIF service offers nothing above ≈1240 px per spread; ask whether the library holds higher-resolution scans of this copy, or find another public-domain copy with higher-resolution images (not investigated in this pilot).

Independent readers: 3 reads by separate readers that cannot see each other's output, majority per character, disagreement → □. This pilot could not do that (no sub-readers allowed), which is why its agreement is self-consistency only.
A glyph reference table built from 7× crops for numerals (一…九 十 百 千 万), units (石斗升合勺) and the recurring holder strings of each 国, read once with care and then used as the comparison set.

Arithmetic the document carries: each 郡 footer gives the number of villages and the 郡高 total; the sum of transcribed 石高 must equal the footer — a deterministic check on the numerals, independent of the reader. The village count already matched for 美嚢郡 (157).
Holders: record the string only; mapping a title (e.g. «松平左兵衛督») to a 藩 needs a separate, cited table — never inferred from the transcription.
